last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription sleep and insomnia topics. The main query set returned 209 unique PubMed PMIDs, 208 fetched article records, and 208 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMIDs: 40918053, 33157425, 17145239, 33905827, 39106912, 34559859, 35325766, 40056718, 36998905, 35268051, 34093972, 38060250, 39501163, 37559551, 30575050, and 35193046. Fifteen retained references were new to the database; PMID 33157425 was linked to the existing melatonin entry. Fifteen new entries across fifteen qualified topics retain numeric intervention-versus-control results or valid relative effects. Tart cherry, yoga, mindfulness, aromatherapy, light therapy, and sleep hygiene topics were linked to existing entries, and melatonin was linked to its existing entry with the new RCT reference. Glycine, tryptophan, milk, probiotic, prebiotic, omega-3, zinc, and vitamin B12 sleep topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect.
